title: Fancy Pulling a Pint?
subtitle: Volunteers wanted for the new pavilion bar
body: The bar in our new pavilion is opening on Thursday, Friday & Saturday evenings — and we're looking for a rota of around 15 volunteers to help staff it. Every shift keeps the bar ticking over, ready for a well-earned pint after a match or a members' event. To get involved, speak to a committee member or sign up at the bar.
